limitations: Stationary spatial marginal only; symmetric Markov on/off switches, normalized diffusivity, positive trap stiffness when on, no equality of temporal/path laws; residual equivalence risk for later semi-Markovian switching literature.
scientific_integrity: The stationary characteristic function and underlying switching model are prior work. The derived Lévy decomposition, sharp OU threshold and driver are assessed mathematical extensions. This review is not independent validation.
title: A sharp Lévy–Ornstein–Uhlenbeck realizability transition for a randomly switched harmonic trap
